svg.text: HomeAuto wiring: Raspberry Pi 5, breadboard, sensors

Modules hang over the top edge with their 3 pins in row a. A wire in rows b-e of the same column is electrically the same point (columns a-e are joined). Pin order shown is illustrative: match your module's silkscreen labels.
Pi to breadboard (female-to-male): 3V3 to rail, GND to rail, 5V to PIR VCC column, plus 6 signal wires. Rails to modules (male-to-male): 5 VCC + 6 GND.
Only the PIR uses 5V (direct from Pi pin 2, no 5V rail). Every other module stays on the 3.3V rail. Power the Pi off while wiring.
